hooks.name: block-deploy-and-push
hooks.description: Humans deploy and push, not the agent. Blocks shell tool calls that run a Maven/Gradle deploy goal or git push.

action.command: payload=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$payload" | grep -qiE '(mvn|gradlew?)[^"]*[[:space:]][a-z:-]*deploy([[:space:]"\\]|$)|git[^"]*[[:space:]]push([[:space:]"\\]|$)'; then echo 'Blocked by workspace policy: deploy and git push are run by humans, not the agent.' 1>&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
